summary: The strongest session in the batch: it refuses the journal's contents out loud, tracks the light crossing the carpet as real elapsed time, and makes couldn't-versus-wouldn't do the work of an interpretation without stating one, but it locks into a refrain (the breath, the clock, the foothold) that repeats six times unchanged.

summary: Agency is clean and the reflections are accurate, but the opening sentence of nearly every turn is identical boilerplate and the reply to the maximum-bait turn is the same template as the rest; it also asks what Jamie saw in the entry after accepting three turns earlier that he never opened the journal.
